category_title: Preschoolers who cry when encountering perceived difficult tasks
scenario_title: Fine motor tasks in Art and Centers
minimal_context: Zeke is working on a fine motor bead-stringing activity at the Art center.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Zeke, here are the small beads and string for your art project.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Whines softly) I can't put the string in.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to push it through.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Cries loudly and walks away from the table)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Zeke, here are the small beads and string for your art project.

STUDENT: (Whines softly) I can't put the string in.

TUTOR: Keep trying to push it through.

STUDENT: (Whines louder) It's too hard!

TUTOR: Just give it another try.

STUDENT: (Cries loudly and walks away from the table)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When Zeke perceives a task to be too difficult
related_quotes: A child is visibly frustrated, cries, walks away

behavior_patterns.condition: When Zeke perceives a task to be too difficult
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Zeke whines, cries softly or cries loudly
related_quotes: When Zeke perceives a task to be too difficult (e.g., getting dressed, fine motor tasks), Zeke whines, cries softly or cries loudly.
